title: Storybound NPC binding
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/npc_bindings/<path>.json — which entities start which dialogue, and how. Every file whose selector matches an entity applies, closest first (by uuid, then by a tag or a name, then by kind with more filters first): each setting comes from the closest file that writes it.

display_name.description: The NPC's name: over its head (unless show_name is off) and in its dialogues, each player reading it in their own language. Only for an NPC by hand (a tag): for every entity of a kind it names nobody, use names.

show_name.description: Show the name over its head. Off: only dialogues use it.

names.description: For every entity of a kind (an NPC without a tag): names to give them, one each, the one least used nearby, so a village has no two alike while the list lasts. Kept for life; shown when looked at.

one.description: For every entity of a kind (an NPC without a tag): one entity only, picked by the mod near a player (an Elder in the first village a player comes to), kept for good: it stays the one when it no longer passes the filters, and comes back when it dies unless respawn is off.

share.description: For every entity of a kind, all such (an NPC without a tag, not one): only this per cent of them (30: about every third villager is a guard). Each entity is rolled once, for good, by its uuid and this NPC; raising it keeps those in and adds others. Absent: all.

entity.description: Which entities talk: one selector, or a list of them; the binding is for any entity that matches one.

dialogues.description: What a click (or the talk key, or coming close) gets, tried by priority, highest first: the first entry whose conditions pass. Each starts a dialogue or says phrases in a bubble, with no conversation. None passing: the click does what it normally does (trading).

phrases.description: Instead of a dialogue: said in a bubble over the NPC, the next line each click ("Wolves again..."); a phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own.

override_interact.description: Right-click starts the dialogue and cancels the entity's vanilla interaction (e.g. villager trade menu).

proximity.description: Coming close starts the dialogue; again only after leaving and coming back.

cooldown.description: Seconds before the same NPC may start it again for the player.

once.description: At most once per player, ever.

exclusive.description: While the NPC talks with one player, others cannot start its dialogues (they get busy_dialogue, or nothing). Off: several players talk with it at once.

busy.description: What others hear while an exclusive NPC talks with one player: a line said in a bubble over it ("Wait, I am busy"), the next of its phrases each time; a phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own. Without it, nothing.

chatter.description: Now and then the NPC says one of its phrases to players near it, while it is free (not in a dialogue, not angry).

phrases.description: What it says: a phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own. With variants, what it says when none applies.

variants.description: What it says as the story goes on: tried by priority, highest first, for the nearest player; the first whose conditions pass is said instead of phrases.

phrases.description: A phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own.

min_interval.description: The pause between two phrases, seconds: from. The first one, a player just come near, after a random 0 to this.

max_interval.description: The pause between two phrases, seconds: to. Each pause is random between from and to.

radius.description: Blocks: it chatters only while a player is this close.

conditions.description: Tested for the nearest player within the radius; it keeps quiet while they fail (night, a quest stage).

when_attacked.description: What the NPC does when a player hits it. Without it, what its kind does (an iron golem fights back). Mobs' hits leave it to its kind.

reaction.description: ignore: no revenge. flee: runs from the player for 5 seconds. fight: goes for the player (only kinds that can attack).

patience.description: For fight: hits forgiven before it fights back, as followers forgive a stray blow in a fight.

warning.description: For fight: said on the hits it forgives (in order: "Careful!", "Once more and..."); a phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own.

phrases.description: Said on every hit it reacts to (for fight, those past its patience); a phrases node, or { "text": ... } of its own.

dialogue.description: Instead of phrases: a dialogue started with the player on such a hit, after the one they are in (a scene: "What are you doing?!").

calm_after.description: Seconds without a hit after which it forgives everything: the reaction ends, the count of hits and the phrases start over.

invulnerable.description: Nothing hurts the NPC (mobs, fire, a fall, players) but the void and /kill. Mobs still go for it.

respawn.description: When the NPC dies or disappears, the same NPC (its name, look, trades and uuid) comes back where it was 5 seconds later. It drops nothing when it dies.

custom.description: Talking to the NPC (talk key or right-click) fires the KubeJS event npcInteract. Its dialogues still start too while interact is on: for the script alone, turn interact off or leave dialogues empty. Needs KubeJS; only for binding files, not /storybound npc bind.
